Suddenly (e) she stopped the song and addressed her 
directly. “Your voice is not blending in with the other girls at 
all. Just pretend to sing.” For the rest of the year, whenever 
the choir sang, she mouthed the words. She recalls, “Chorus 
was supposed to be my favorite thing. My family said I could 
sing, but the teacher said I couldn’t. So I started to question 
everything.” She began to act out, hanging out with the 
wrong crowd at school. It was a dark time.
